title: Recipe box with ingredient scaling
when: The user wants an app to save their own recipes, search them by name or ingredient, and scale ingredient amounts to a number of servings.
prompt:
Goal: Recipes that are quick to enter, easy to follow while cooking and scale to any serving count with friendly fractions.
Steps:
1. Recipe { id, name, servings, tags[], ingredients: [{ qty, unit, item }], steps[] }.
2. logic.mjs: parseIngredient("1 1/2 cup flour") handling whole, fraction and decimal; scale(recipe, servings); formatQty showing 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 3/4.
3. List with search over name, ingredient and tag, plus tag filter buttons.
4. Detail: servings stepper, ingredient checkboxes to tick while cooking, steps in an ol; Wake Lock request in Cook mode when supported, in try and catch.
5. Editor: ingredients and steps as textareas one per line, parsed on save with errors naming the line.
6. Persist in localStorage recipes.v1 guarded; print styles hide controls.
7. test.mjs: mixed numbers, 4 to 6 servings, fraction output.
Quality bar:
- Amounts read like a cook writes them.
- Steps readable from a distance in Cook mode.
- Items without a quantity (salt to taste) survive scaling.
Pitfalls:
- 0.333333 cups.
- Scaling the stored recipe instead of the view.
- Losing the original servings.
Verify:
- [ ] Ingredient checkboxes labeled.
- [ ] Scaling tested.
- [ ] Data reloads.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (parse, scale, format), test.mjs.

examples.input: caderno de receitas onde eu ajusto as porcoes
examples.output: search, tags, servings 4 to 6 turns "1 1/2 xicara" into "2 1/4"
